description: ShellX Cut desktop — core webview + IPC for the LOCAL (tauri://) origin: the bundled fallback/bootstrap page before the webview navigates to the engine-served UI. App IPC commands are covered by core:default here. The global-shortcut grants let the SHELL register the OS-level F9 record hotkey. The engine-served REMOTE loopback UI gets dialog, event-listen, window-fullscreen, and the narrow update-preference permission through an exact-origin runtime capability built in lib.rs after the engine port is selected.
